newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle up $0.50 to $1, light test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle up $0.50 to $1, light test - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $0.50 per cwt higher in a light test, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow to moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest light, instances moderate. Offerings fairly light.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 1175-1300 lbs 70.00-71.00. Heifers- Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs 70.00-71.00.
On a c carcass basis (weight only) compared to Tuesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 higher.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 112.00-113.00 few Choice 114.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 103.50-104.50
Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 112.00-113.00.
